title: Laravel Controller Semantic-Judgment Boundary Coherence
changes: Aligned LaravelControllerInvocationSemanticBoundaryContract interface version and exported value to version 83.
Added explicit contract boundary for preserving the exact ControllerVariableSemanticJudgment returned by the existing executor.
Documented that source-projected Expression and judgment expressionValue are distinct domain representations.
Preserved canonical invocation judgment and integrated response as separate values.
remaining: controllerDataflowAnalyzer still orchestrates calls to existing semantic authorities and composition stages.
This phase does not claim the analyzer is wiring-only.
